reference.stdout:
Inspect, plan, copy, and verify local RAW or FLAT/ZERO/hosted-sparse/streamOptimized VMDK sources (RAW destinations)

Usage: reference-cli [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  recover  Explicit local recovery of retained output; no network or cleanup
  inspect  Inspect a RAW file, base VMDK descriptor or supported sparse container
  plan     Preview logical work and destination policy; does not create or write output
  copy     Copy logical bytes to RAW; publish new output without replacement
  verify   Compare source bytes with the destination prefix; no writes
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json     Emit schema-versioned JSON; errors go to stderr
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
